evidence.title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models

summary: A new technique called WAM-OPD enhances AI world models by improving on-policy distillation, enabling more efficient and accurate decision-making in complex environments. The method aims to bridge gaps in reinforcement learning and model-based AI systems.
title: Researchers Introduce WAM-OPD: A Novel On-Policy Distillation Method for World Action Models
